session_note: Illinois's 104th General Assembly is a genuine two-year biennium (convened January 2025, does not adjourn Sine Die until January 2027 when the 105th GA is sworn in), so any bill still pending in a committee at the end of 2025 carries automatically into 2026 without refiling or renumbering. The Illinois Senate uses successive 'Rule 2-10' committee-deadline extensions (and, once a deadline lapses without committee action, a 'Rule 3-9(a)' re-referral to the Assignments Committee) to keep bills technically alive rather than letting them die outright; a Rule 3-9(a) re-referral to Assignments is a parking mechanism, not a formal death, and ILGA's own status pages never label these bills 'dead,' 'failed,' or 'Session Sine Die.' Several bills in this packet (SB2181, SB3120, SB3761, SB3830, SB4004, SB4016) show an identical late-session pattern: deadline extended from an original date through 2026-04-24, then 2026-05-15, then a further undocumented-in-packet extension to 2026-05-22, at which point the deadline lapsed and the bill (with any pending amendments) was re-referred to Assignments under Rule 3-9(a) on 2026-05-22 with no recorded action since. This mirrors what already happened to HB3574, SB0094, and SB2290 in 2025 (re-referred to Assignments in April-June 2025 and untouched since), which remain formally pending, not formally dead, more than a year later. None of the 11 bills in this packet has been reported out of committee, passed both chambers, or enacted as of 2026-07-31, except that HB3574 did pass the House on 2025-04-10 (114-1-0) and is now stalled in the Senate Assignments Committee.
